I have farmed this small plot for many years, and my cassava grows well enough with the rains God provides without buying costly chemicals from the market. I have kept my own cuttings from last season's harvest, and I will spread some chicken and goat manure I gathered during the dry season to help the roots grow strong. My family will clear, plant, and weed this land ourselves—it is only a small plot, so we do not need hired workers, and I have no money for pesticides or irrigation.
